native.global_reduction: Each quarter can execute the complete chunk8 reduction; no unpriced or reordered cross-quarter partial sum. Compiler prices duplicate work.

ports.physical_boundary: Only registered 337/273 service and protected command/completion cross quarter boundary; native wide buses remain inside quarter

calendar.native_clock: 0.9 GHz parent clock, enabled only after actual service replies and visibility receipts
calendar.virtual_edge: Snapshot PRE-edge read/write ports, advance native one edge, serve captured reads and publish captured writes, then repeat
calendar.read_scan: finite increasing cursor; disabled seats skipped; response checked by real tag before operand capture
calendar.publication: write ACK followed by same-sector read reproducing scalar before retirement
calendar.enabled_read_additional_edges: actual request/response latency + protected reply capture
calendar.enabled_write_additional_edges: actual write ACK + actual visibility read + comparison
calendar.latency_per_program: sum measured virtual edges and enabled reads/writes/visibility reads; never assign fixed service delay or token rate before real measurement

physical.arithmetic_area: reuse source-matched real c12 lane/reducer masters; no light/XOR envelope credit
physical.command_fanout: registered broadcast stages5; actual256 light/64SFU lanes
physical.replica_mux_demux: four service endpoints, actual native scalar/address snapshot seats per lane, finite completion barrier

exactness: Real c12 FP32 arithmetic; native690 decoded fields, held fixed-latency virtual sampling, golden chunk8 order. No DPI or host arithmetic qualifies the RTL.
